user.title: Connect Filen
user.description: Log in with your Filen account. Your password is only used to log in and derive your encryption keys; it is not stored. Filen rate limits failed logins, so please check your details before trying again.

data_description.email: The e-mail address of your Filen account.
data_description.password: Your Filen password. It derives your encryption keys once and is then discarded.

two_factor.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor.description: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app. Every wrong code counts as a failed login at Filen.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Filen again
reauth_confirm.description: The connection to Filen for {email} has expired. Enter your password to log in again.

error.invalid_auth: E-mail or password is wrong. Failed attempts are rate limited by Filen, so please check before trying again.
error.invalid_2fa: The 2FA code was not accepted. Wait for a fresh code and try again.
error.account_blocked: Filen has locked or blocked this account. Check your account at filen.io or contact Filen support.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Filen. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.preflight_failed: Login worked, but the connection test (create folder, upload and download a small file) failed. Details are in the Home Assistant log.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Details are in the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Filen account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: This is a different Filen account than the one set up here.

auth_failed.message: Filen rejected the login. Please log in again.

account_unusable.message: The Filen account cannot be used for backups: {error}

quota_exceeded.message: Not enough space in Filen for this backup: {error}

update_failed.message: Could not read the Filen storage usage: {error}

entry_not_found.message: No Filen account with the ID {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Filen account {title} is not loaded.

no_access_to_path.message: Home Assistant is not allowed to read {filename}. Use a folder like /media or /config/www, or add it to allowlist_external_dirs.

file_exists.message: {path} already exists in Filen. Turn on overwrite to replace it.

invalid_path.message: {path} is not a valid Filen path.

duplicate_name.message: {name} appears more than once; upload one file per name at a time.

backup_folder_protected.message: {path} is in the backup folder {folder}. Delete backups in Settings → System → Backups instead, so Home Assistant keeps track of them.

overwrite_incomplete.message: The new version of {path} was uploaded, but moving the old version to the Filen trash failed ({error}). Both versions are now in the folder; delete the old one in Filen.

upload.name: Upload files
upload.description: Uploads files from Home Assistant to Filen, encrypted on this device. Only files in allowed folders (for example /media or /config/www) can be uploaded.

config_entry_id.name: Filen account
config_entry_id.description: The Filen account to upload to.

filename.name: Files
filename.description: Full paths of the files to upload.

destination_folder.name: Destination folder
destination_folder.description: Folder in Filen, subfolders separated by /. Missing folders are created.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace a file with the same name. The new file is uploaded first; only then the old version is moved to the Filen trash.

delete.name: Delete files
delete.description: Deletes files in Filen. By default they are moved to the Filen trash. Backups can't be deleted here; use the backup settings.

config_entry_id.name: Filen account
config_entry_id.description: The Filen account to delete from.

path.name: Paths
path.description: Paths of the files in Filen, for example Home Assistant Uploads/front_door.jpg.

permanently.name: Delete permanently
permanently.description: Delete right away instead of moving to the trash. This cannot be undone.
